requirements.rule: BAKERY PREMIUM CUMULATION (art. 29, PANIFICAZIONE, PDF p. 119): the premiums marked * are 'Cumulabile con le altre maggiorazioni in misura non superiore al 55%'; the engine applies the higher premium alone, as for the other tables, so overtime at night or on holidays of the panificazione is underpaid.
requirements.remediation: Cumulate the panificazione premiums marked * up to 55% above the highest one.
Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.
